  PROBLEM: `_merge_self_incomplete` hard-codes the `github.com` host, so on GitHub Enterprise Server it fails to exclude the workflow's own in-progress check from the strict snapshot.
  WHY: That check remains eligible and makes the snapshot `not_ready`, withholding auto-merge; severity differed between BLOCKER and MAJOR, so the highest severity is used.
- scripts/collect_pr_check_runs_context.py:443-456, 488-498 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: When `CHECK_RUNS_AUTOFIX_ENABLED=false`, `main()` exits with a disabled sentinel before evaluating strict-merge checks.
  WHY: `fresh_merge_checks_ready()` requires a ready snapshot, so auto-merge enrollment is withheld for every clean PR in repositories with this setting; severity differed between BLOCKER and MAJOR, so the highest severity is used.
- scripts/collect_pr_check_runs_context.py:95 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: An API error produces a zero-count snapshot that `fresh_merge_checks_ready()` reports with the same warning as an empty or invalid snapshot.
  WHY: The shell function does not distinguish an unreachable API from bad check-run evidence, obscuring the reason enrollment was withheld.
- scripts/collect_pr_check_runs_context.py:334-347, 488-498 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `_strict_merge_runs` is called twice on the same raw text to produce the readiness decision and context output.
  WHY: The calls currently agree because the function is deterministic, but future non-determinism or environment-dependent logic could make the emitted snapshot disagree with the readiness verdict.
- scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh:193-232 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `fresh_merge_checks_ready` adds one check-runs API call per clean-review enrollment.
  WHY: The call is bounded and fails closed, and the reviewer reports no runtime failure.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/collect_pr_check_runs_context.py:37-48 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `_merge_self_incomplete` hard-codes `https://github\.com` in its URL regex, so on GHES the in-progress self-check is not excluded from the snapshot.
  WHY: The self-check remains incomplete in the strict merge snapshot and withholds auto-merge indefinitely.
- scripts/collect_pr_check_runs_context.py:443-453 and 488-498 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: When `CHECK_RUNS_AUTOFIX_ENABLED=false`, the collector exits with a disabled sentinel before strict-merge evaluation, and `fresh_merge_checks_ready` does not override the flag.
  WHY: The disabled sentinel fails the header checks, so a repository with this setting cannot enroll a clean PR in auto-merge.
- scripts/collect_pr_check_runs_context.py:334-347 and 488-498 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `_strict_merge_runs` is called independently in `main()` and `_build_context_text` on the same raw text.
  WHY: Both calls currently agree, but future non-determinism or environment-dependent logic could make the readiness decision and emitted snapshot diverge.
- scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh:193-232 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: `fresh_merge_checks_ready` adds one additional gh api call (check-runs) per clean-review enrollment.
  WHY: The API call is bounded (no-wait, single page of the check-runs endpoint) and fails closed; the reviewer reports no runtime failure.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The PR adds observable auto-merge failure modes (withholding enrollment with warnings). CLAUDE.md 20 requires exactly one uniquely named changelog fragment for PRs that change observable behavior.
  Expected change site: changelog.d/6086-fresh-clean-merge-checks.md (or similar)
  Evidence of absence: glob(changelog.d/*6086*) returns no files. The PR diff adds no new file under changelog.d/. The PR introduces two new observable failure modes: "Fresh check-run collector is unavailable" and "no verified fresh green check-run snapshot" warnings that operators will see in workflow logs. No fragment documents this behavior change.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Missing, malformed, incomplete, failed, or moved-head evidence must withhold enrollment, not masquerade as green." The issue requires refreshing check runs before enrolling auto-merge. The operator documentation in README.md must describe this new prerequisite.
  Expected change site: README.md lines 2451-2458 (Enabling auto-merge section)
  Evidence of absence: No diff hunk updates README.md. Line 2451 still says auto-merge happens "right after setting ai:ready-to-merge." Line 2457 still says "No branch protection | PR merged immediately after review passes." Both claims are now incomplete: enrollment is additionally gated on a fresh, same-head green check-run snapshot after model execution, with fail-closed cases for invalid, not_ready, and api_error snapshots.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/collect_pr_check_runs_context.py: lines 45-48 (`_merge_self_incomplete`) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The regex hard-codes `https://github\.com` when matching the workflow's own check-run URL, ignoring `GITHUB_SERVER_URL`.
  WHY: On GHES the self-check is not excluded, remains eligible and incomplete, and causes `fresh_merge_checks_ready()` in scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh:193 to withhold auto-merge on clean-review PRs.
- scripts/collect_pr_check_runs_context.py: lines 443-453 (the `CHECK_RUNS_AUTOFIX_ENABLED=false` early-exit in `main()`) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The collector writes a `disabled` sentinel and returns before the `strict_merge` block, while `fresh_merge_checks_ready()` accepts only a ready snapshot.
  WHY: Repositories that disable check-run context collection have every clean-PR auto-merge enrollment withheld.
- scripts/collect_pr_check_runs_context.py: line 95 (`total_count != len(runs) or total_count == 0` final-rejection inside `_strict_merge_runs`) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The zero-count `api_error` snapshot is treated like an empty or invalid snapshot by the shell parser.
  WHY: `fresh_merge_checks_ready` warns that there is no verified fresh green snapshot without distinguishing an empty snapshot from an unreachable API, obscuring why enrollment was withheld.
